record.title: Aolani announces plans for 22,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs across Malaysia and the Philippines
record.summary: Aolani’s September 21, 2026 announcement says it expects to deploy 22,000 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs across two AI factories in Malaysia and the Philippines in early 2027. It says the collaboration brings its AI factory capacity above 100 MW and total deployment above 48,000 GPUs. These are forward-looking company statements: this review did not verify financing, construction, permits, delivery, operational capacity, utilization, or NVIDIA’s corroboration.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: Aolani says it expects to deploy 22,000 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs across two AI factories in Malaysia and the Philippines in early 2027, bringing its total deployment above 48,000 GPUs. The announcement also says its AI factory capacity will exceed 100 MW. These are future plans, not verified deliveries or operating capacity.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: Aolani’s announcement labels statements about future capacity, infrastructure plans, services and regional expansion as forward-looking. This source alone does not establish financing, permits, construction, delivery, independent corroboration, power availability or utilization.

evidence_gaps.description: The source is Aolani’s own forward-looking announcement; NVIDIA corroboration and project-level financing, permits, construction, delivery and utilization were not checked.
The announcement does not specify how much of the stated capacity is committed, energized, available to customers, or allocated to each location.

brief.importance_rationale: If the announced plan is delivered and made usable, 22,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs across Malaysia and the Philippines would materially expand planned regional AI compute capacity. The announcement is prospective and does not establish financing, delivery, operational availability or utilization.
limitations: The 22,000-GPU deployment is announced as expected in early 2027, not as delivered.
More than 100 MW is a company-stated planned capacity figure; no site-level power or commissioning evidence was checked.
The stated total above 48,000 GPUs is prospective and does not establish installed or operational units.
Financing, permits, construction, offtake, NVIDIA corroboration, customer access and utilization were not verified.

technical.claimed_result: Aolani says 22,000 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs are expected across Malaysia and the Philippines in early 2027; it says this raises total planned deployment above 48,000 GPUs and factory capacity above 100 MW.
technical.demonstrated_result: The official company newsroom page publishes the announcement and explicitly frames future deployment and capacity statements as forward-looking; actual delivery and operation were not independently established.
technical.mechanism: Aolani describes two planned AI factories and NVIDIA-powered cloud services in Southeast Asia.
technical.regime: Company-announced infrastructure plan covering Malaysia and the Philippines, with 22,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs expected in early 2027 and stated combined capacity above 100 MW. No project-level implementation details were verified.
technical.reproducibility: The announcement is publicly accessible. Its future deployment claims have not been independently verified; no operational measurements were available in this review.
technical.strongest_baseline: No like-for-like regional capacity or operational deployment comparison was included in the announcement or this review.

brief.title: Aolani announces plans for 22,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs across Malaysia and the Philippines
brief.why_it_matters: If delivered and made available, the announced deployment would add substantial planned AI compute capacity in Southeast Asia. The announcement provides a bounded company claim about scale and location, while leaving the delivery timeline, financing and usable operating capacity unverified.
